claim: Does a fixed neuroendocrine-lineage surface-antigen RNA panel nominate a previously unreported, reproducible EMC tissue-localization experiment beyond established neuroendocrine differentiation?
selection: Panel assigned biologically before this pilot. Existing broad discovery-table rows for SEZ6 and NCAM1 were exposed during prior-work search before this freeze: SEZ6 median0.48TPM, NCAM1 median10.63TPM with negative LGFMS/synovial contrasts. This is exploratory re-evaluation and source reuse, not blinded independent discovery or a new confirmatory three-gene experiment. No new expression values read yet.

prior_art.neural_EMC: Filion2009 already reports neural differentiation and selected genes; full383-probe supplement availability/novelty unresolved for panel.
prior_art.CD56: Published CD56-positive EMC observations exist: PMID35488288 molecularly confirmed cellular EMC; PMID24713246 aggregate5/5 CD56-positive, case molecular identity unresolved; PMID27591381 focal positive lung case with molecular identity unresolved. PMID24185117 two vulvar PLAG1-positive NR4A3/EWSR1-negative tumors are not automatically authenticated EMC. Known CD56 positivity is not discovery.
prior_art.DLL3_SEZ6: Focused full-text-index query six hits requires source eligibility check; no direct EMC DLL3/SEZ6 measurement shown in the inspected indexed abstracts. No first-ever claim.

specific_addition: A consistent, appreciable transcript signal for an unreported panel member across authenticated EMC specimens, separable from relevant sarcomas in two assays, could justify prioritized tumor-cell localization testing. RNA alone does not show accessible antigen, dependency, safety or treatment efficacy. Failure of an invented broad panel hypothesis is not a negative paper.
strongest_alternatives: Neuroendocrine lineage in EMC does not imply SCLC target expression.
NCAM1 expression is nonspecific and could be carried by neural or immune compartments; bulk admixture and low tumor fraction can confound all genes.
RNA measurements cannot establish membrane localization, isoform accessibility or protein abundance.
Known CD56 measurements and neural signature are prior art, rather than a new application inferred from terminology.
Sequencing year, reference design, gene annotation and unresolved donor overlap can create apparent validation.

sources.RNAseq: All704 Hofvander columns, all13 author-labelled EMC specimens (12primary+1recurrence). Primary9 exclude three documented historical overlaps and recurrence; retain all13 sensitivity with labels. Reuse exact metadata-manifest and hashes. No additional molecular confirmation invented.
sources.array: All42 GSE24369 specimens:6EMC,17LGFMS,6MFS,6desmoid,5SFT,2pooled muscle. All uniquely assigned GPL6244 clusters, median within gene/sample fixed when >1; cluster-specific contrasts also report.
sources.older_array: All10 author-labelled EMC GSE4303 ratio conditions retained if unambiguous annotation supports panel. Ratios conditional on CRH reference; GIST UHR cannot validate tumor abundance. No favorable-probe selection.
sources.coverage: Refresh primary papers/supplements/citations plus reuse prior verified EMC tissue, authenticated model and broader-deposit identity gates. Generic chondrosarcoma, disputed models, uncertain donor identities stay separate; suitable accessible pending measurements block advancement.

comparators.primary_array: LGFMS anchor; MFS,desmoid,SFT separately as contrary/context comparisons
comparators.broad_RNA: Every eligible diagnostic category descriptive; malignant reference policy reused from CSPG4 benchmark, no selection by gene values.
comparators.normal: Array muscle pools descriptive, not donor replication; known normal neural antigen context required for any advance, not a safety conclusion.

metrics: Per-gene exact observed signal, median/range, counts≥1 and≥5TPM (allocation context only)
Probability of superiority half ties; bootstrap95%CI within cohorts seed20261005 B10000
Sequencing-year matched A and individual EMC deletion; recurrence/overlap inclusion sensitivity
Array all clusters and source-scale values, no cross-platform abundance pooling
analysis.multiplicity: Three assigned genes plus prior thousands-gene screen exposure. One-sided three-primary-comparator intersection-union p and Holm across3 shown if computed, always exploratory; no p-value validates novelty.
analysis.allocation_rule: Potential new localization lead only if RNA median≥5TPM and each primary EMC≥1TPM, A≥0.8 versus all three primary histologies marginal/year-matched, consistent array direction and A≥0.8 versus LGFMS, no contradiction from complete relevant measured EMC evidence or primary prior art. This operational rule is experiment allocation, not biological absence or a clinical cutoff.
analysis.stop: If appreciable unreported reproducible contrast fails, or identity/coverage/novelty cannot be established, shelve this claim; no post-hoc switch to a selected high case, fusion subgroup, threshold or renamed panel. Preserve individual high observations.
analysis.decisive_followup: Complete bounded three-gene RNA/array source projection and panel prior-art eligibility; only source-backed promising contrast justifies staged extra work.

restrictions: Owned R8surface_targets path only; main read-only.
Shared raw sources read-only with no new duplicates; raw/new full sources ignored; ≥10GiB free and64MiB source softcap.
